subject: Request: Confirmation of VM Scan Cadence, SLA and CVE Closure Evidence
messages:
From: Acme Security <sec-reqs@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joel Patel <joel.patel@sigverify.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VM scan cadence, SLAs and CVE-2026-3141 closure evidence

Hi Sofia,

We're compiling the final evidence package for our SIG review and need to confirm Redwood's vulnerability management posture for Q4. Specifically: 

- Canonical scan cadence for internal infra and customer-facing services (weekly, biweekly, monthly?).
- Expected SLA for critical/high CVE patching window that you commit to for Acme (we have a contractual expectation to assert an 72-hour critical SLA).
- Proof of closure for CVE-2026-3141 (this was flagged in our pen test in September) — ideally remediation logs and a scan showing it no longer appears.

Can you provide an official statement and any artifact bundles you can share? We can treat some artifacts as redacted if necessary. Deadline for inclusion in SIG: 2026-11-10.

Thanks,
Danny Cho
Acme Security
sec-reqs@acme.com

Attachment: acme-sig-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Security <sec-reqs@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM scan cadence, SLAs and CVE-2026-3141 closure evidence

Hi Danny —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answer up front: we can provide a signed statement on cadence and SLAs, plus a scan artifact bundle and the remediation log for CVE-2026-3141. We will mark any infrastructure-specific hostnames as redacted for the public bundle.

Planned deliverables (ETA 2026-11-05 COB PT):
- Signed VM cadence & SLA attestation (PDF).
- Consolidated scan artifacts (Nessus/Qualys aggregate + a hashed manifest) — attached as vm_scan_report_202610.zip.
- CVE-2026-3141 remediation log (CVE-2026-3141_remediation_log.pdf) showing patch deployment timestamps and verification steps.
- Scan schedule .ics showing weekly internal scans and monthly external scans (scan-schedule.ics).

SLA note: Redwood's internal target for critical CVEs is 72 hours for customer-impacting services with active exploitability, and 14 days for high severity. For enterprise customers with a dedicated contract (like Acme), we can confirm 72-hour critical SLA in writing and provide evidence of adherence for the past 6 months.

If you need a short paragraph we can embed into your SIG narrative, say so and we'll provide it as a signed PDF with an engineer + security lead signature.

I'll loop in Evelyn from Security to validate the remediation packet.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: vm_scan_report_202610.zip (will be uploaded to shared drive), CVE-2026-3141_remediation_log.pdf (attached in final mail)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: VM scan cadence, SLAs and CVE-2026-3141 closure evidence

Team — forwarding Acme's request. Marcus: can you pull the October consolidated scans and include the hashed manifest (no raw hostnames in the bundle)? Laura: please prepare the signed SLA/cadence statement (PDF) with the standard legal footer. Evelyn: validate the remediation log for CVE-2026-3141 and confirm the verification steps.

Key constraints:
- Redact customer-specific hostnames but preserve timestamps and patch build IDs.
- Provide a short one-paragraph statement for SIG describing cadence: "Weekly internal dynamic scans (authenticated), monthly external unauthenticated scans, and continuous pipeline scanning for images."
- Ensure the remediation log shows the 72-hour closure window and that verification scans were run post-remediation.

Please put artifacts in the shared drive folder and ping me when ready — I'll assemble a single bundle for Acme.

Onward,
Sofia
